name: tenancy-rules-tests
description: Security-rule tests for the multi-band data model. Runs against the local Firestore emulator only.

scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-peatmoss "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/rules.test.js test/storage-rules.test.js test/band.test.js test/migrate.test.js test/trash.test.js test/reminders.test.js test/billing.test.js test/legal.test.js test/account.test.js"
scripts.test:stripe: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-peatmoss "NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt node --no-warnings --test --test-concurrency=1 test/stripe-api.test.js"
